adminless_features.go preserves the duration number grammar reviewed in
attoparsec0.14.4 Data.Attoparsec.Text.scientifically/rational. The implementation
uses Go integer arithmetic and preserves native fixed-Pico conversion before
multiplying the unit, instead of importing/embedding Haskell. BSD3 notice retained
for source and future binary/container distributions. Source module copyright:
